message.content:
This editorial illustration on a magazine cover features several distinct visual elements set against a cream background. At the top, the large red text "TEMPO" dominates, with "PEMAIN IMIGRAN DI PIALAL EROPA" written above it. Centered on the right is the bold black title "PETAK UMPET KILANG TUBAN" followed by smaller descriptive text in Indonesian.

The main graphic depicts a large, stylized arm and hand extending from the left. The arm wears a black sleeve with a white cuff and a white abstract three-point logo. The hand is bright red, with a pointed index finger pressing down on two smaller human figures. These figures, a person in a white cap and orange pants and another in a dark suit, are shown in an active stance, holding their arms upward as if supporting the weight of the giant finger above them. The bottom left corner contains publication details like "6-12 JUNI 2016", "RP 39.500", and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302".
